behavior: The private /kit/directions page shows three hero comps side by side so Sasha can pick the visual direction
acceptance: Given KIT_ENABLED=1, when /kit/directions loads, then three hero comps labeled A Dawn Path, B Dusk Ledger and C Halftone Horizon are visible, each with a headline, a primary button and one product panel
Given a production build without KIT_ENABLED, when /kit/directions is requested, then the response is 404
notes: 2026-10-08 review fail by subagent: Functional acceptance met: kit.spec.ts passes 3/3 when I re-ran it (three labeled comps, each with h3, Join waitlist button and product-panel; noindex meta; 404 on the server without KIT_ENABLED). The gate reads process.env at request time (lib/kit.ts plus force-dynamic layout). formatTokenAmount is exact bigint math, and its tests cover values above 2^53, 18 decimals and negatives. Sample data is labeled. No secrets. DEFECT (material, visual contrast): apps/web/src/components/directions/dusk-ledger-comp.tsx:15 uses var(--scrim), but COMP_UI.dusk (apps/web/src/constants/art.ts:46-53) has no 'scrim' key, so the scrim gradient never renders. Because of that, on the 390px screenshot the B Dusk Ledger subhead (muted #C2B6AE, 18px body text) sits on the orange horizon glow. Pixels sampled from .impeccable/review/b-mobile-crop.png give contrast of 1.36-2.23:1 on the right half of lines 2-3 (for example x365,y440 bg 173,131,111 = 1.69:1; x365,y468 bg 195,148,117 = 1.36:1). WCAG AA needs 4.5:1. Fix: define the scrim color, or move or darken the text so the subhead reaches at least 4.5:1 at 390px, then re-shoot the screenshots. Non-blocking: 'Join waitlist' is repeated 4 times across the comp components (D-11 repeated literal). apps/web types are flat files (src/types/invoice.ts) instead of the src/types/<domain>/ folders ui-web uses. formatTokenAmount shows '-0.00' for tiny negative amounts.
